description: This file defines the AjaxResponse class, which provides a standardized structure for AJAX responses including status, data entries, validation messages, and JSON serialization logic.

classes.name: AjaxResponse
classes.description: A class representing an AJAX response with status, data, validation messages, and JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: getValidationMessages
methods.description: Returns the map of validation messages.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the list of data entries.

methods.name: addDataEntry
methods.description: Adds a data entry represented as a map of string key-value pairs.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a single key-value pair to the data map.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the status message based on a Throwable's message.

methods.name: setErrorString
methods.description: Sets the status message directly from a string.

methods.name: addValidationMessage
methods.description: Adds a validation message for a specific field.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with basic response info, including status and optional message.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the entire AjaxResponse object into a JSON string, including data, validation messages, and additional info.
